Add the following outcome metrics:

 * file bug frequency: the total number of commits of all bug type issues the file was involved
 * file bug churn: the total churn sum of commits of all bug type issues the file was involved
 * file non-bug frequency: the total number of commits of all non-bug type issues the file was involved
 * file non-bug churn: the total churn sum of commits of all non-bug type issues the file was involved

A similar "file churn" metric function was also added for consistency.

commit.message:
i #206 #211 Adds GoF/Text Parsers

This adds two methods to the identification of GoF 
Patterns, and a text module to Kaiaulu. 

The text module is a wrapper to srcML.
`text.R` defines a basic interface to obtain
the XML and a sample function to query it 
and tabulate the output to R memory. 

The GoF pattern relies on pattern4.jar by
Tsantalis. It wraps around the jar and 
tabulates the output to R memory. 

An example of how to use both new third
party tools can be found on gof_showcase.Rmd

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

commit.message:
i #209 fixes performance issues

The following was modified:

- graph_to_dsmj() was further vectorized and profiled.
   - run time should have further been cut to 1/3
- a filter_by_commit_size() function was added. This
  is in fact the reason why graph_to_dsmj() ran ran
  so slow. Migration commits can easily lead to an
  explosion of edges. This resolves that problem.
   - dv8_showcase.Rmd and two conf files were updated
     accordingly, to use the new filter function and
     tested to work on a large project, whereas before
     it was nonviable.
- a progress bar was added to parse_dv8_architectural_flaws()
  The ticks are marked per folder of flaws analyzed instead
  of instances due to a limitation on progressBar that resets
  the tick on a loop. Loop of Loops progress bar hence does not
  work. Less than ideal for now, but better than none.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

commit.message:
i #200 fixes check and tests, and actions

When executing the commands devtools:check() and
devtools::test(), files specified in unit tests can
be located by devtools::test() by assuming the function
is executing from kaiaulu/tests/testthat ; however this
assumption is not valid for devtools::check()

The end result is that the checks always fail, and thus
the GitHub actions will also always fail.

The solution was found on https://stackoverflow.com/a/71334780
which specifies files which unit tests rely on should be placed
within the unit test folder. Moreover, said file paths should be
referred by a special function test_path().

When defined in this manner, both the check and test function will
work, as the file paths will be adjusted accordingly. This
unfortunately introduces a redundancy in the files, and also
partially defeats the intent of some of these tests: I.e. to
aid the user in verifying if their tools.yml define the correct
path. Future README.md recommendations to run unit tests will
hence require the user to copy their tools.yml to the testdata
folder to execute said assumption.

This commit also fixes GitHub Actions to install perceval before
executing the tests. Moreover, the Actions will update the
tools.yml with the remote machine path to the installed perceval.
Due to what is described above, GitHub Actions will also copy on
the remote machine only the updated tools.yml to the testdata folder,
as someone would need to do manually, so the unit tests can verify
the Perceval setup was done properly.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #153 Kaiaulu's Bugzilla Downloader (#177)

Adds downloader functions for Kaiaulu to download
Bugzilla JSON for issues and comments separately.

commit.message:
i #184 Generalizes DSMJ export for graphs (#195)

The dv8_dependencies_to_sdsmj() and 
dv8_gitlog_to_hdsmj() were generalized 
into associated transform_*() and 
graph_to_dsmj() functions. In addition, 
one additional transform was made to 
exemplify the generalization of 
graph_to_dsmj() using the temporal 
gitlog network parser.

Fundamentally, any graphs in Kaiaulu can 
now be exported by creating a minimal 
transform function and passing it to
graph_to_dsmj.

The graph_to_dsmj function also serves as 
a specification of the format which is 
compatible to both Depends and DV8, 
further facilitating the integration of these tools.
In particular, both unimodal undirected and 
directed graphs can be represented in this 
format, and multi-edge weights can also 
be represented.

---------

Signed-off-by: Leilani Reich <reichld@hawaii.edu>
Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #184 modularizes bipartite projections

bipartite_graph_projection() now accepts a weight_scheme
function to decide how to assign weights to the nodes of
the resulting projection. When a function is missing,
the intermediate projection table is returned instead.
This can be useful for users trying to create their own
weight function to the API, or just to utilize as-is.

Commonly, projections are performed as weight sum. A new
weight scheme function, weight_scheme_count_deleted_nodes(),
can now also be used to assign weight to the projection edges.
This function is appropriate, for example, when computing the
co-change metric.

Various notebooks which relied on the function, and other API
functions were also updated accordingly with the appropriate
weight schemes.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #192 adds testthat output

While the R CMD check workflow actually runs
testthat, when it is successful it only outputs
"OK". This includes on test/coverage the full
output of tests for inspection if needed.

If a unit test fail, both R CMD and the code coverage
will both fail, and provide the full unit test output
too.

across functions, and the following checklist was reinforced:

 * Titles describe files relating to function name acronym
 * Body describes file extensions used in DV8/DV8 Guide
 * Parameters dependent on other functions output are hyperlinked (backwards pipeline referencing)
 * Functions hsdsm were renamed to mdsm for consistency with DV8 manual
 * A DV8 Showcase Notebook exercises a full end-to-end pipeline from raw data to final analysis.
 * Project configuration file has been extended for DV8 parameters and is used on DV8 Notebook.
    * Users may change the project configuration file to re-run other analysis.
 * See Changelog for other details.

Pending on #190:

 * @seealso must be added consistently to recommend subsequent function (forward pipeline referencing)

commit.message:
i #189 fixes parse_depencencies variables

This fix modifies parse_dependencies() to also
include the "variables" field obtained from Depends file.
The function output has been modified to return a list
 of two tables, nodes and edgelist. The prior
implementation would lead to files which have
no dependencies to other files to being missed entirely.

Associated network functions have been modified to account
for the new node table information, and the R Notebooks
which use them updated accordingly.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #184 fixes no changes file renaming

In instances when a commit modifies a file name
without changes, Perceval includes the new file
information under "newfile" field, as opposed of
"file".

For cases where after a file rename without content
changes, said file is never modified again in the
git log history, the new file name will never be
included in the parsed git log.

This fix now parses the "newfile" field and it
includes as part of the parse_gitlog() information.

It also overwrites the "file" field with the "newfile"
field information, so the new file name is correctly
included in the git log in cases where no future changes
happened to the file.

In the future, the "newfield" information can be used to
properly rename all past file ocurrences, for analysis
which treating the new file as a separated file could
be wrong.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #172 fixes truncated Depends file paths

Fixes replacement of folder_path to a normalizedPath
so that the full file paths generated by Depends can
be turned into relative paths.

The issue occurred when the provided path was relative,
e.g. "../../rawdata/project". In this instance,
while Depends would generate a list of full file paths,
the replacement string would be relative, causing
truncation errors.

By correcting the folder_path to full file path,
the erroneous truncation should no longer occurs.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #185 parse_mbox only renames existing fields

parse_mbox() has been modified so it does not assume
every .mbox file constains a fixed number of fields.
Rather, it will only identify from a list of fields
of interest those that exist in the data, and rename
them accordingly.

The function documentation was also updated to indicate
due to this change, the number of columns in the resulting
table may change depending on the data.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

require specifying a commit hash range for each branch.
To simplify, the CLI now relies on the datetime range

The social smell notebook continues to rely on commit hash
interval as it is more precise for exploration.

A smells interface was added to CLI to compute
smells over multiple branches. The code is in

loaded branches from the project configuration
file.

A single table will be generated containing the
smells analysis, in addition to a column specifying
the branch it is associated to.

incorrect interval being shown in the last table

commit.message:
i #75 Fixes tools.yml OSLOM paths

Previously, the path to undir and dir community
detection for OSLOM were inverted. This fixes the issue.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #75 fixes naming of parsed dependencies

parse_dependencies() now returns consistent column
names to the other networks derived from `graph.R`.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #75 Adds built-in bipartite projection

Kaiaulu now has a built-in bipartite projection.
The bipartite projection function allows to compute
two types of projections, which is reflected on the weight.

In one mode, which is equivalent to the method commonly used
in graph libraries such as igraph, the number of unique nodes
deleted is calculated as the projection weight.

In the new mode, the original weights in the bipartite graph
are sum across the deleted nodes. By default, Kaiaulu implements
this method.

It is also possible to return a intermediate projection table,
which shows the original weights and the name of the removed node,
in order to calculate the graph weights as done in other libraries
or other method for combining the original weights.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #43 #89 #90 #91  Release Kaiaulu 0.0.0.9500

Several changes were made to improve the clarity
of the codebase, at data, function and parameter
level. Kaiaulu now defines a base nomenclature
for common data types instead of using data
"as-is" from third party software, which on
occasion would be cryptic.

Network operations are now prefixed as
"transform_*_to_<type>_network"
functions instead of "parse_*_network", which
overlapped with the parser.R module causing confusion.

A few other quality of life improvements were made. See NEWS.md
for the full change log.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

commit.message:
i #82 add filter for entities per time window

A new filter function in R/filter was added:
parse_by_last_files_change(). This function has
the equivalent behavior of git_checkout() and
searching for the folders for the existing files,
but leverages the already loaded in memory
parse_gitlog() output to reconstruct them.

This function can be used in combination to
parse_gitlog_entity() to analyze larger projects
such as OpenSSL, where blaming every commit can
take days.

The assumption of the function is that, within a
specified time window of interest, collaboration
is quasi-stationary and while a threat to validity,
can still be used and has been used in the past
in publications.

See vignettes/gitlog_entity_showcase.Rmd for usage.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #84 add dependency graph for R

The API functions have been sitting around for awhile,
but no vignette has been created. This commit address
that by adding vignettes/kaiaulu_architecture.Rmd

This will also facilitate observing if any future changes
poorly impact the architecture as new changes are made
and facilitate package navigation.

New API functions were added to the docs, and R/io.R
documentation was fixed.

A bug was also found in the function construction graph
which led to incorrect edges being assigned due to searching
for the caller function across all functions definitions
instead of the file being analyzed.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #29 remove branches from parse_gitlog

Currently we use a number of flags recommended by
Perceval README. However, in retrospect some of these
flags behavior are not clear. This commit removes 2
of them which include branches.

In the future, we should be able to pass the flag choice
to the project configuration files.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #83 add progress bar to entity parser

Parsing entities per commit per file may take
over one hour even on small projects. This adds
an option to show a progress bar.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #81 add setup and config for OSLOM

Updated tools.yml to include OSLOM binaries,
and added setup instructions on README.md

Minor change on R/graph.R to allow OSLOM binaries
to be placed anywhere user prefer.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #81 add oslom and refactor R/network.R

Separates R/network.R into R/graph.R to facilitate
identifying useful networks from various software
development artifacts, and their representation into
graphs and associated algorithm interfaces.

The vignettes/community_detection_showcase.Rmd shows
how to use the new OSLOM function.

Identity management usage was simplified as a consequence,
see vignettes/merging_networks_showcase for examples.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #79 add git log entity parser and networks

Adds git log entity parser and associated network
functions. See NEWS.md for details.

Some control handling has been added to R/git.R blame,
which must be improved over other git functions for
cases such as when a blamed file exists on the git log
but was deleted (blame is empty).

A new case of git blame format was also identify and
added to R/parsers.R.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #78 add git log temporal network

Adds an implementation of dev-dev networks
in which dev A points to dev B if dev B changed
a file after dev A. The function creates a
collaboration network directly from the gitlog,
without having to first construct a bipartite
network.

Signed-off-by: Carlos Paradis <carlosviansi@gmail.com>

i #2 modify parse_line_type()

Modifies parse_line_type() to be
compatible with parse_git_blame().

Instead of expecting a folder of files,
a single file content can be provided instead.

A vignette was also added showcasing how to use
both functions in combination and providing some
rationale and background work.

The project configuration file has been extended
to allow for selection of different parameters for
parse_line_type().

License headers were also added for new API files.

Adds a git blame parser. Note this is a git
